source_conditions: CFG_SUPPORT_PWR_LIMIT_COUNTRY=1 enables the manufacturing power step.
Actual TAG3 presence sets runtime SINGLE_SKU en. Without TAG3, legacy remains a separate unimplemented branch.
Runtime SKU en selects rlmDomainSendPwrLimitCmd_V2 after source domain setup.

selected_soc3_initializer.omitted_C_static_initializer_values: null file pointer and zero batch size; no claim about unobserved later runtime mutation

v2_flow: Allocate and initialize power arrays to source integer MAX_TX_POWER=63. This is not a selected legal EIRP or a replacement for rule max_eirp_mbm=0.
Attempt configured file load; derive table version from buffer; caller ignores load failure when dispatching. Absence of a dat file alone does not establish that source waits or refuses.
Version0 uses CID49 table batches with ucTxPwrLimitBatchSize as division denominator; version1 uses the separate CID5d per-rate path and optional beamforming backoff.
The selected bounded source assignments to file/batch appear only in mt7663/mt7668 initializers. Copying those values into SOC3 is unsupported.
required_before_native_domain_nvram_scan: Consume actual TAG3/PHY on the owned retained worker to identify SKU branch.
If V2 is selected, resolve the actual selected SOC3 country power input/table-version/batch contract and define a bounded refusal for missing/null/zero inputs before allocation/division/publication.
Do not declare an active runtime bug from these source conditions alone: TAG3 and the runtime branch are not yet observed.
Do not substitute unrelated-chip defaults, invent a country table, silently omit source power initialization or treat rule metadata as its completion.
implementation: No power command or file parser added. Evaluator power_path_resolved always remains0.
